description:
Ethereum mainnet bundle: several reads in one paid call. Ethereum mainnet wallet check in one paid call: for one address, returns its ETH balance (eth_getBalance), nonce (eth_getTransactionCount) and contract bytecode (eth_getCode), each keyed by part name. Returns: each named part service's own result, in one paid call, keyed by the part's name -- exactly what each part returns when bought alone; the call succeeds only when every part answers. It takes the union of the parts' query parameters.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_wallet_bundle. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_wallet_bundle
